# Mega Techzy

Mega Techzy is a digital marketing and website development company established in 2019. We provide website development, SEO, paid advertising, automation, analytics and lead-generation services for businesses in Solapur City, Ravet, Dehu Road and Wakad.

## Important Pages

- [Home](https://www.megatechzy.com/): Digital marketing and website development overview.
- [About](https://www.megatechzy.com/about): Company background and service approach.
- [Services](https://www.megatechzy.com/services/): Website, SEO, advertising, automation and analytics services.
- [Blog](https://www.megatechzy.com/blog/): Practical guides about websites, SEO, advertising, analytics and lead generation.
- [Contact](https://www.megatechzy.com/contact): Enquiries and contact information.

## Priority Services

- [Website Development](https://www.megatechzy.com/services/website-development): Business website planning and development.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://www.megatechzy.com/services/seo): Technical, content and local SEO services.
- [Google Ads](https://www.megatechzy.com/services/google-ads): Search advertising and conversion measurement.
- [Lead Generation](https://www.megatechzy.com/services/lead-generation): Lead-generation strategy, landing pages and measurement.
